## Checklist
- [ ] Lint, format, typecheck and tests pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] `docs/SPEC.md` updated if behaviour or the data model changed
- [ ] ADR written if a significant decision was made
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or personal data in the diff
- [ ] I can explain every line of this PR
